name: lavieenrose
note: La Vie en Rose is a Canadian (Montreal-HQ'd, Francois Roberge) lingerie brand; the .com.sa site is the foreign brand's franchise-operated local storefront. Fails Gate 1 (foreign HQ) and folds into its local operator under Gate 6.

name: IMALCO
note: The 'building_materials' tag is wrong, but IMALCO self-describes as 'Qatar's first and largest automotive distributor' selling tires, car batteries and lubricants. Hard-excluded under Gate 2 (automotive parts/tires/batteries + distribution).

name: GULF ADVANTAGE AUTOMOBILE LLC
note: Exclusive distributor of Renault vehicles in Saudi Arabia (8 showrooms, 38 service centers, 23 parts outlets). Automotive dealership, hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: Masdar - مصدر
note: Al Muhaidib's Masdar is Saudi Arabia's leading building/construction-materials distributor (steel, timber, cement, plumbing, electrical, hardware; 105 branches, 80,000+ SKUs). Construction materials + distribution, hard-excluded.

name: Musaed Mohammed Bin Ajlan Co
note: Wholesale/retail distributor of electrical, plumbing, lighting and sanitary materials for construction/renovation. Construction-materials/hardware category is hard-excluded regardless of the retail arm.

name: Mannai HECV Group
note: Mannai's Heavy Equipment & Commercial Vehicles division (cranes, JCB, forklifts, tractors, trucks, buses). Heavy equipment/construction machinery/commercial vehicles, hard-excluded.

name: National Building and Marketing Company
note: Trades building materials and manufactures iron/steel, aluminum/glass carpentry, and metal scaffolding (Tadawul-listed, Riyadh). Construction materials + manufacturing, hard-excluded.

name: neyam
note: Narrow memory-foam sleep/bedding brand (foam pillows, shredded foam, body pillows, blankets/comforters). Fits the Gate 3 narrow/low-repeat-purchase exclusion in the mattress/bedding pattern.

name: narscosmetics
note: Not building materials -- it is the official NARS cosmetics KSA storefront, but operated by Chalhoub Group (Dubai-HQ'd) for Shiseido. A single foreign brand's franchise storefront: fails Gate 1 and folds into the operator under Gate 6.

name: Manahil International Company
note: Verified as a Nissan automobile dealership in Saudi Arabia (vehicle sales, showrooms, test drives, service). Automotive, hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: Nissan Kuwait
note: Authorized Nissan dealership in Kuwait (Al-Babtain). Automotive dealership, hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: نسمو | Nasmo
note: The live nasmoltd.com is a Sudan/UAE solar-energy company (fails Gate 1 geography and category); the separate Saudi 'Nasmo' is an F&B manufacturer. Neither is a qualifying Saudi consumer retailer.

name: Petromin Corporation
note: Saudi lubricants manufacturer and automotive-services group (Petromin Express, fuel retailing, Nissan dealership; Al-Dabbagh Group). Automotive + manufacturing + fuel, hard-excluded.

name: Q Mart | كيو
note: Domain on file resolves to an unrelated US (Texas) convenience chain. The Saudi 'Q Mart' appears to be a supermarket chain with a customer-loyalty/engagement platform (q-mart.online), not a fuel station, but no transactional online store, app scale, or Saudi HQ could be confirmed -- genuinely unresolved.

name: Petromin Nissan
note: Petromin's Nissan vehicle dealership (Petromin acquired the Nissan dealership in KSA in 2016). Automotive, hard-excluded under Gate 2.

name: Bafarat Industrial Group
note: Not automotive -- Rana Food is a Jeddah food manufacturer (sauces/condiments) selling B2B/wholesale via distribution and trade shows, with no consumer cart/checkout or retail stores. Manufacturing + no real digital channel (Gate 2/Gate 4).

name: serajah
note: Domain 301-redirects to expireddomains.com (parked/expired); a targeted search found no successor site for the camel-leather goods shop. Fails Gate 4 (no live store).

name: Raha
note: The 'realestate_facility' tag was a false positive from the parent's 'Warehousing' name. Raha is a genuine Kuwait-HQ'd pure-play automated e-grocery (founded 2020, $6.7M seed, ~25,000 grocery SKUs, live iOS + Android apps). Grocery is approved and Kuwait HQ + scale/app qualify it; the site is only temporarily under maintenance.

name: BEAM
note: Not automotive -- shopbeam.com is a US wellness/supplements brand (sold via Sprouts and Amazon in the US), not a Saudi company. Fails Gate 1 geography; no Saudi retail operation identified on this domain.

name: renault
note: Official Renault Saudi Arabia brand site (vehicles, dealer locator, test drives), operated for the KSA market by the local Renault distributor. Automotive, hard-excluded; also a brochure/dealer site with no cart.

name: Strong Rent a Car
note: Not building materials -- a Qatar car-rental/leasing company (est. 2003, ~1,500-vehicle fleet, 7 branches, limousine services). Car rental (automotive + hospitality/travel), hard-excluded.

name: sulindastore
note: The 'building_materials' tag is a keyword false positive. SuLinda is a Saudi health-retail brand selling food supplements, vitamins, collagen, protein and sports nutrition across many categories, with 3 KSA stores, a live online store, and distribution through major KSA pharmacy chains. Approved health-retail category, Saudi HQ, real digital channel and scale.

name: sarinamultiple
note: Saudi authorized agent/distributor of automotive batteries, oils and filters (Riyadh, with Jeddah/Dammam branches). Automotive parts + distribution + narrow low-repeat line, hard-excluded under Gate 2/Gate 3.

name: teearabia
note: Definitely not building materials -- a Riyadh-based (founded 2011) apparel site, but it centers on custom/branded corporate uniforms and promotional items for organizations (schools, cafes, factories, charities, teams), straddling consumer apparel retail and B2B custom-printing service; catalog breadth could not be confirmed (site rate-limited), so qualification is genuinely unresolved.
